about: Remote images on OxyOS (images.h, crates/oxyos-image's remote, crates/oxyos-net's cache; sample/RemoteImageProbe.tsx), from the scenario's own store, which serves cloud.oxy.so's images with their caching headers through the machine's proxy and TLS, as Android's React Native loads them through Fresco and OkHttp. At once: a 160 x 80 PNG of two halves covering a 96 x 48 box (fetched, decoded off the JavaScript thread at the box's pixels, its load told with the bitmap's size), an SVG document (by its Content-Type, Skia's SVG module rasterising it at the box's pixels), a 404 failing once with its status, Image.getSize and getSizeWithHeaders of the first two once shown (from the memory cache, never asked again), and two images prefetched into the application's disk cache (its cache directory's images/). Each event once per source (loadStart, progress, load or error, loadEnd), each image asked of the server once. Revalidate: Image.queryCache says the PNG is in memory, the prefetched ones on disk and the 404 nowhere; the prefetched no-cache image is asked again with its ETag, answered 304, and drawn from the disk cache. Slow and Unmount: an image arriving 64 bytes at a time is unmounted while it loads: its request is cancelled (the server sees it cut), and nothing more is told of it. Offline and Force cache: with the machine offline, a prefetched image whose response is stale is drawn by cache: 'force-cache' from the disk cache, and one never fetched fails once.

steps.name: Slow: an image arriving slowly starts loading, its progress told as it arrives
Unmount: the view goes while it loads; its request is cancelled and cut, nothing more told of it
Offline: the machine's network goes away
Force cache: the stale prefetched image drawn from the disk cache offline, told once; one never fetched fails once
